hero.name: Armin Safaie
hero.tagline: From first wireframe to deployed, production-ready site.
hero.bio: Builds with React, Next.js and TypeScript, styles with Tailwind CSS and Bootstrap 5, and connects to Laravel/PHP APIs when a project needs one. Writes tests with Jest and React Testing Library, and treats responsive design, performance and accessibility as requirements — not afterthoughts.

contact.blurb: Have a project that needs a frontend built end-to-end — wireframe to deployed site? Reach out directly.

highlights: Delivered WordPress websites for clients across industries — a corporate site for an international energy, agriculture and engineering consultancy, a bilingual e-commerce store, and a personal-training portfolio site.
Developed React.js applications, including a cafe digital menu backed by a Laravel API and a recipe site for browsing and discovering recipes.
Owned each project independently end-to-end — gathering requirements, structuring content, and testing every build across browsers and screen sizes before handoff.

projects.name: Wonka Menu
projects.summary: Designed and built a cafe's digital menu in under 2 weeks — a React.js frontend backed by a Laravel API — structuring menu items and categories into a fast, easy-to-browse interface across mobile and desktop.

projects.name: Shekamo Food
projects.summary: Developed a React.js recipe website with a clean, browsable interface for discovering recipes by category.
projects.result: Gained organic traffic through social media and word-of-mouth sharing after launch.

projects.name: Petropedaco
projects.summary: Delivered a WordPress corporate website for Petropedaco, an international consulting and engineering firm, in about 3–4 weeks, translating its multi-sector, international scope into a professional, content-managed site.
projects.result: Client reported the new site felt noticeably faster, with fewer support complaints after launch.

projects.name: Parriot
projects.summary: Launched a bilingual (Persian/English) e-commerce website, handling product catalog structure, language switching and localized content.
projects.result: Client began generating real sales and orders through the site after launch.

projects.name: shayankalateh.com
projects.summary: Designed a WordPress portfolio site for a personal gym trainer with a fast, mobile-friendly build the client could manage and update independently.
projects.result: Client reported receiving new client inquiries directly through the site after launch.
